plugins.name: registry-mcp
plugins.displayName: Company Check — UK, Sweden & Norway business registers
plugins.description: Check a company before you deal with it. Look up an entity in its own national business register — the United Kingdom (Companies House, by company number), Norway (Brønnøysundregistrene / Enhetsregisteret, by organisasjonsnummer) and Sweden (Bolagsverket, by organisationsnummer) — in one identical JSON shape: registered name, legal form, status, address, industry codes, VAT/MVA registration, and the statutory filing deadlines with the provision each one cites. Bundles the hosted read-only MCP server (no account, no key), a skill that teaches the counterparty, filing-deadline and register-coverage workflows, and three commands: /check-supplier, /filing-deadlines and /enrich-company-list. Not sanctions or bank-detail screening.
